patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Trello and Wrike share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Comparison thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Trello only if your buying job matches “Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.” rather than Wrike's shape. Choose Wrike only if your buying job matches “Enterprise/agency work management with proofing, intake and resourcing — Team from $10/use” rather than Trello's shape. Workflow advantage: Trello leans shared coverage; Wrike leans work-management, resource-planning. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Trello and Wrike share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Trello is Lightweight Kanban boards (Atlassian) — Free; Standard from $5/user/mo annual.; Wrike is Enterprise/agency work management with proofing, intake and resourcing — Team from $10/user/mo annual..
- Company-size focus: Trello (micro, small-business, mid-market) vs Wrike (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Trello-leaning — vs Wrike-leaning work-management, resource-planning.
- Researched limits: Trello — Limited planning depth vs Work OS; Wrike — Business tier pricing jump.

Limitations — Trello: Limited planning depth vs Work OS; Premium needed for richer views; Wrike: Business tier pricing jump; Heavier admin than lightweight tools.

Poor-fit cases: Trello is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Limited planning depth vs Work OS · Wrike is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Business tier pricing jump · Avoid Trello if you actually need Wrike's motion (Enterprise/agency work management with proofing, intake and resourcing — Team fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
